evidence.reason: The current code still gates result-cause extraction on `observation.error === undefined` at line 743. When the dispatch catch has already recorded `observation.error` (and `errorKind = 'dispatch-threw'`) and the result frame itself has error status, the extraction block at lines 744-759 is skipped, so `resultCause` remains undefined and the classifier sees only the dispatch-throw classification. That can misclassify an error-result cause as a harness failure. This is a routine correctness defect in existing behavior, not a new requirement; the smallest compatible fix is to derive the result-frame cause when the result status is error even if a dispatch exception was also recorded, or otherwise give the result-frame cause precedence for classification.
